text:
Maya (Marketing): Quick heads-up — IrisOS agreed to a short case study. Can we lock interview + quote approval timeline? Proposed embargo 2024-06-10 (one week after interview). Need a launch post, webinar blurb, and a benchmark callout. :tada:

Liam (Content): Love it. Can do a 30-min interview. Suggested slots: Wed 10–12 PST or Thu 9–11 PST. I’ll draft 6 interview Qs and two quote variants (conservative/assertive). Need final quote by Fri EOD to hit copy deadlines.

Evan (Design): Heads up — we’ll need logo (SVG), 16:9 hero screenshot (PNG 2x), and a 1200x628 launch image. If IrisOS can’t provide screenshot, we can mock one but prefer a real sanitized shot. Also would like headshots if they’ll be webinar speakers.

Raj (Legal): Standard approvals: logo permission + release form. Please send our release template and ask them to sign. Redline guidance: avoid PII and exact customer revenue numbers; latency and % improvements are usually okay if they confirm. If they want to include raw latency (ms), we’ll need a short attestation from their eng team.

Sofia (Sales): I’ve spoken with Clara (PM) and Omar (Eng) at IrisOS — mornings PST work best. I’ll book Thu 10am PST and invite Clara + Omar. They’re open to a speaker slot on the webinar but want to confirm availability after interview. I’ll also push for a specific % decrease number for the benchmark mention.

Maya (Marketing): Thanks Sofia. Two asks: 1) Can Legal sign off on including this line if they confirm: "IrisOS reduced inference cost by ~40% and cut tail latency in half"? 2) Can we get an embargo window of one week post-interview so comms/sales can prep?

Raj (Legal): Q1: We can approve that phrasing if IrisOS confirms and provides measurement notes. We’ll require their sign-off on the final quote. Q2: Embargo is fine. Send the release; I’ll review any quote copy by Thu morning. :white_check_mark:

Liam (Content): Draft quote options (will refine):
- Conservative: "IrisOS saw a ~40% reduction in per-token inference cost after migrating to Redwood Inference, while maintaining model quality."
- Assertive: "IrisOS cut token costs by 40% and reduced 95th-percentile latency by ~50%, enabling faster search responses for customers."
Which would Legal be more comfortable with? :eyes:

Raj (Legal): Conservative is safer. Assertive can be OK if they provide test data and sign off. Please make sure the final quote includes "according to IrisOS" if it’s based on their internal tests.

Sofia (Sales): Confirmed — Clara prefers the conservative line unless their Eng team signs off on the latency table. Clara said they can share anonymized test results by Thu.

AssetUploaderBot: Transcript uploaded: gs://redwood-marketing/irisos/1717535120-irisos-interview-transcript.txt

Maya (Marketing): Perfect. Liam — can you drop the draft Qs + quote options into the shared drive and tag Raj? Link in thread when ready. Also, set a pin for the embargo date and the speaker ask.

Liam (Content): Done — draft Qs + quote options: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b-irisos-draft. Pinning doc now.

Evan (Design): I’ll mock two hero options for review once we have the screenshot/logo. Expected deliverable by Wed EOD.

Sofia (Sales): Meeting invite sent for Thu 10am PST. Invited: Clara (IrisOS PM), Omar (IrisOS Eng), Maya, Liam, Raj, Evan.

Maya (Marketing): Great. Timeline recap: interview Thu -> legal quick review Thu -> final quote by Fri EOD -> embargo release 2024-06-10 -> webinar scheduling (prefer mid-June). Any blockers? :thumbsup:

Raj (Legal): No blockers on our end. I’ll drop the release template in the thread now.

Liam (Content): One last note — for the webinar blurb I’ll propose a single-slide benchmark highlight and a 60s customer video clip. If IrisOS can sign off on a short clip, it’ll help conversion.

Maya (Marketing): Thanks team — we’ll regroup after the interview.

Sofia (Sales): On it. Clara confirmed headshots can be shared after the interview.

Liam (Content): Tagged Raj on the doc for quote sign-off. Will iterate post-interview. :rocket:
